mentions.name: GetSetReply
mentions.description: SaaS that helps small businesses collect and manage customer reviews. It sends automated review requests to customers over SMS or email after a purchase (point-of-sale integrated or manual sending) and generates AI draft replies in the brand's voice for existing reviews on Google, Yelp, and TripAdvisor. Currently seeking beta users; free signup with no credit card or integrations required.
mentions.problem: Small businesses want more customer reviews and need help replying to the reviews they already have.
mentions.source_excerpt: GetSetReply is a SaaS I've been building. It does two things for small businesses: 1. It helps you get more reviews by sending automated requests for reviews to your customers over SMS and/or email after they purchase from you (PoS Integrated / Manual Sending) 2. The second is helping you reply to the reviews you already have with AI-generated drafts in your brand's voice that you can send to Google/Yelp/TripAdvisor.
